name: OrcaSlicer Mobile
subtitle: OrcaSlicer on iPhone and iPad
description: Builds of the OrcaSlicer mobile app, published from GitHub Actions.

apps.name: Orca Beta
apps.subtitle: Slice and send prints from your phone.
apps.localizedDescription: OrcaSlicer on iOS: import STL, 3MF, OBJ and STEP models, pick printer, filament and process presets from the OrcaSlicer profile library, slice on device and send the G-code to Moonraker or OctoPrint.

versions.localizedDescription:
Features:
• Printer-connection plugins as a destination kind
• Run slicing-pipeline and script plugins
• Show plugin pages in the app
• Embed the python plugin runtime in the core
• Orca cloud plugin catalog behind a feature flag
• Add the Android module of the Nitro package and an Android app build
• Build the slicing core for Android with the NDK

Fixes:
• Read the PAL build's version from the ADP manifest
• Merge OCCT 8's libraries from lib/occt into the core archive
• Strip debug info from the merged Android archive
• Keep a capped slice from waiting forever on its thread barrier
• Restore portrait after fullscreen and drop a doubled percent unit
• Keep the viewport drawing large toolpaths on a device

Fixes:
• Adopt the UIScene life cycle so iOS 27 SDK builds launch
• Declare export compliance and explain local network access
• Start the altstore branch on the first publish

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Orca Mobile connects to your printers on the local network to send G-code and show print status.
